  > PSI-123, four walkthrough bugs. (1) nativeButton: BoardFinancePanel's 'View full ledger' is <Button render={<Link/>}> without nativeButton={false}, so Base UI logged its native-button error and the element lost button semantics. Added nativeButton={false}; the console is clean on the Finance tab. (2) Drag swallows clicks: Kanban's useSensor(MouseSensor)/useSensor(TouchSensor) had no activation constraint, so dnd-kit started a drag on mousedown and the browser never fired a click - every click target inside a card was dead, not just the finance button (and keyboard 'Add New Task' was the only working path). Fixed with activationConstraint { distance: 5 } on both sensors, the remedy named in features/cpm-evm.md; verified by replaying a real pointerdown/mousedown/pointerup/mouseup/click sequence and seeing the finance dialog open. (3) Category combobox: NOT a combobox or SQL defect - listCategoriesAction already filters archived = false; it was only unreachable through the card, which (2) blocked; with (2) fixed the dialog lists the 11 seeded categories (0 archived in the DB) and selecting one sticks. Added categories.test.ts to pin the archived = false query and the signed-out refusal, because nothing covered it. (4) Event-form date-time picker: the fields were bare <input type='datetime-local'> inside a modal dialog, whose native popup does not survive the dialog taking focus back, so a date could not be chosen. Replaced with a DateTimePicker component (Popover + Calendar + a time input, the convention already used by DatePickerField) that keeps the WIB wall-clock string contract ('YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', wibInputValueToISO unchanged) and a hidden input for FormData. An early typecheck failed on 6 syntax errors in the gitignored .next/dev/types/routes.d.ts the dev server was rewriting; removing it made tsc exit 0. Branch naming: task/PSI-NNN per the operator and the Phase 11 brief; README_AI_AGENT.md section 5 still shows agent/PSI-0XX-slug.
